License texts are included alongside this notice. Existing source headers are retained.
SOURCE_MANIFEST.json records the SHA-256 of each source module captured
from the historical inference dependency closure on 2026-10-21. Dataset modules
are retained only because the original package initializers import their symbols;
this adapter never instantiates those datasets or reads XPolicyLab trajectories.
Whitespace-only packaging changes are listed separately; executable Python ASTs
were verified identical (ignoring docstring whitespace).
